fills.name: a name built from names.json for the card's flavour: one of its templates, each placeholder filled with a word from the list of the same name

fills.A: A or An, whichever fits the next word
fills.size: the label of the card's size, in lower case
fills.flavour: flavour_word of the card's flavour in names.json
fills.class_noun: class_nouns of the card's flavour in names.json, for the card's class
fills.summary: the first sentence of the signature variant's summary

pitch.note: Not in the sheet: the size label is written in lower case, and {A} is A or An to fit the next word.

fills.name_word: a word from the lists that signature_words names for the card's flavour in names.json
fills.category_noun: a word of signature_nouns in names.json for the signature pattern's category

team_play_hook.hook: the first of the signature pattern's team_play.hooks that the card's flavour favours, else its first

fills.extra_lines: the first sentence of player_translation.as_user[0] of each extra ability's pattern, in order

fills.escape_lines: the escape of every hard-control part on the card (rules.json hard_control): the pattern's own player_translation.as_target line at its escape index, or the line in escapes for a latch delivery or for a weapon of an HC7 family

as_target.note: Not in the sheet: a line that is already in the text is not repeated (hijack-vehicle's escape is its as_target[0]).

fills.line: player_translation.teammates[1] of the signature pattern, or teammates[0] when it has only one line

teammates.note: Not in the sheet's first form: the team-play hook takes the first teammates line, so this field takes the second, and the card does not show one line twice.

controls.each: one entry per bound input, in the order of rules.json layout: seat is the seat that owns the part, input is the layout's input for the part's slot, action is the template in actions for that slot

fills.weapon: the label of the weapon's family
fills.ability: the name of the ability's pattern
fills.trait: the label of the key-bound mobility trait

controls.note: Not in the sheet: section 11 says one entry per bound input, by the layout, but gives no wording for the action, so the action is the plain name of the part.

fills.why: the why of the pattern's link (a variant's overrides replace the base block's list); a link derived from the card's parts (N4) takes the sentence in derived_reasons for its link kind

counterplay.each: one entry per line: counterplay[0] and counterplay[1] of the signature pattern, then counterplay[0] of each extra ability's pattern

inspiration.each: patterns: every pattern on the card; source_units: up to max of the signature pattern's source_units, picked by the seed

derived_reasons.damage: This kind of damage works well against this unit's armour, shields or body.
derived_reasons.hits: It flies, so weapons that can reach its height can bring it down.
derived_reasons.class: It has no weapon that hits fliers, so aircraft can attack it freely.
derived_reasons.armour-class: Its weapons deal damage that is strong against this armour.
derived_reasons.armour-model: Its weapons deal damage that breaks through this kind of protection.
derived_reasons.nature: Its weapons deal damage that works well on this kind of unit.
derived_reasons.target: Its weapons deal damage that is strong against this kind of target.

escapes.latch: Something is clinging to you: hold F to throw it off.
escapes.cryo: Break the line of fire and the frost stops building.
escapes.emp: Get out of its fire and your machine comes back to life in a moment.
escapes.psionic: Break its line of sight and its grip on your mind fades.
escapes.magnetic: Get out of its beam and you drop free.

neutral.signature_effect: Its signature ability comes from the pattern listed under inspiration.
neutral.team_play_hook: It works best when a teammate follows up on what it starts.
neutral.as_user: Your signature ability shapes how you fight, and the rest of your kit backs it up.
neutral.as_target: Learn what its signature ability does and fight it where that ability cannot help it.
neutral.teammates: Teammates who stay near it can make the most of what it does.
neutral.tells: Its signature ability has a look and a sound that both teams can read from above.
neutral.counterplay: Fight it where its signature ability is of no use.
neutral.strengths: This is what its abilities let it do well.
neutral.weaknesses: This is the price it pays for what its abilities do.
neutral.counters: Its abilities give it the edge over this kind of unit.
neutral.countered_by: This kind of unit has an answer to its abilities.
